info.description: The routes the paired companion app calls, under /companion/v1/. Every route except the pairing exchange needs the device credential as a bearer token and a device capability (`x-sidekick-capability`). A successful answer is the structured content of the MCP tool of the same name (contracts/mcp-tools.generated.json). Instances may leave rooms out (SIDEKICK_ENABLED_ROOMS); a route of a room that is switched off answers 404.
info.title: Sidekick companion API
